sandbox_limitations_explicit: Production web/desktop renderer bundle: vite production build peaks beyond the 3GB sandbox memory ceiling (documented since round 1) — built on the CI runner instead (pnpm build:bootstrap in the workflow).

Desktop dev-renderer module graph: Chromium exhausts its per-process request budget while vite dev transforms ~2000+ modules on 2 vCPU — net::ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES on 4225 requests, DOM stays empty (bodyLen 0, tidCount 0); page reload retries against the warm vite cache did not recover. Diagnostics captured in journey/journey-evidence.json + journey-run.log (trimmed) + dom-dumps/S0-failure.json + screenshots/S0-failure.png. The complete renderer journey therefore runs on the CI runner.

No Docker in the sandbox: the inherited desktop E2E container suite cannot run locally — runs in the workflow's inherited-desktop-e2e job via the upstream-sanctioned scripts/test-desktop-e2e-container.sh.
